title: Mesa Royalty Trust 8-K Filing — April 2026 Distribution Announcement
summary: Mesa Royalty Trust filed a Form 8-K on April 17, 2026, furnishing a press release (Exhibit 99.1) announcing royalty income and income distribution for April 2026. The filing is a standard SEC disclosure by The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company, N.A. as trustee, with registered units (MTR) traded on the NYSE. The press release containing actual distribution figures is not included in the source body.
key_points: Mesa Royalty Trust filed Form 8-K on April 17, 2026 (date of earliest event).
The filing announces royalty income and income distribution for the month of April 2026.
The trustee is The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company, N.A.
Units of Beneficial Interest (ticker MTR) are registered on the NYSE.
The press release (Exhibit 99.1) is furnished but not filed pursuant to SEC Release No. 33-8176.
